name: genpark-realtime-voice-agent-latency-telemetry-skill
description: End-to-end conversational voice agent latency telemetry profiler tracking VAD, STT, LLM-TTFT, TTS-TTFB, and playout bottlenecks.
author: AlphaPark

tools.name: record_pipeline_event
tools.description: Record a stage transition timestamp (VAD, STT, LLM_START, LLM_TTFT, TTS_TTFB, PLAYOUT).

tools.name: compute_turn_latency_breakdown
tools.description: Calculate stage-by-stage latency breakdown and critical path for a conversation turn.

tools.name: generate_sla_diagnostic_report
tools.description: Produce SLA latency percentiles (P50, P90, P99) and bottleneck diagnostic.

tools.name: run_benchmark_telemetry_profiling
tools.description: Simulate and benchmark multi-turn voice session latency analytics.
